review_scope: Original is the only soundbank (operator 494): the alternative-bank override is removed. DrawStep draws from the Original set's pool and its single per-surface shuffle bag, exactly the path fresh Original already took (the alternative branch was skipped when no bank was selected); Play passes bHoof (formerly bOriginalOnly) through unchanged, so hoof stand-ins keep their plain AtelierPlaySound playback and human footsteps keep their owned voices with the soften/volume preferences. Surface detection, plant timing, landing, hooves, the tick and per-voice preferences are byte-identical. The offline profile still represents the default Original mix; no new hardware listening is claimed.
